answer: Our security kernel utilizes quadratic slashing where detected malicious behavior triggers the total depletion of sable liquidity commitments to prevent Sybil proliferation. Marginal attack costs scale super-linearly, forcing expenditures to navigate a reef of escalating staking requirements that mathematically exceed extractable protocol value. This mechanism, coupled with zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions, ensures negative expected utility and maintains a robust Nash equilibrium at the consensus layer.
